concerns.text: Task T003 requires downloading real ACE/WIND composition CDF files for 2000‑2020, but Constitution Principle VI (Composition Data Integrity) blocks any real composition data download because no open source exists. Without a Principle VI amendment, this task cannot be executed as specified.

Task T007 (full regression) is conditional on a Principle VI amendment and the presence of real composition data. Since the amendment is not yet recorded and real composition files are unavailable, the task cannot be performed, leaving FR‑005, FR‑006, and FR‑011 uncovered.
Task T008 computes ΔR² and cross‑validation, but both rely on the full regression model produced by T007. With T007 currently unexecutable, T008 cannot produce its required outputs.
Task T009 generates a bootstrap confidence interval for ΔR², which depends on ΔR² from T008. Since T008 cannot run, T009 is also unexecutable.
Task T010 (block permutation test) is conditional on real composition data and a Principle VI amendment. Without those, the script cannot run, violating FR‑008.
Task T011 (Benjamini‑Hochberg FDR correction) depends on permutation results from T010; given T010 is blocked, T011 cannot be executed.
Task T012 (sensitivity sweep) requires the FDR‑corrected p‑values from T011. Since T011 cannot run, T012 is also unexecutable.
